summary: BioVie Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement priced November 3, 2026 and closed November 5, 2026. The company sold 960,000 Class A shares at $1.60 and 2,002,500 pre-funded warrants at $1.5999 (exercise $0.0001), plus 2,962,500 common warrants at $1.70 exercisable beginning six months post-issuance and expiring five years later. Aggregate gross proceeds were approximately $4.74 million before fees, for working capital; no advisor was named. Structure carries warrant overhang; watch dilution and Nasdaq compliance.
